text:
maya: RC ready: build/artifact 2026.03.21-rc-47 (sha: ab12cd34). Requesting promo to prod during 03:00-04:00 PT window. Pin artifacts and hold until QA + perf readouts. @chris @sandeep @eva please ack
chris: ack from infra, pinned GPU fleet to v2.11. deploybot, can you schedule canary to 1% traffic in us-west1?
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled canary -> prod: artifact ab12cd34, 1% traffic in us-west1, start 03:15 PT. Canary timeout 20m. Commands: `deploy start --artifact ab12cd34 --canary 1 --region us-west1`
sandeep: QA: smoke passed in staging, but perf harness shows median latency +8% at p95 for long prompts. digging
eva: Observability: telemetry alert on non-prod env: tail error-rate +0.7% after RC integration. Unclear if noise. Sharing quick graphs: https://dashboards/redwood/rc-47
maya: Thanks. Let's hold full promo until we validate telemetry. Proposed plan: run canary in us-west1 1% -> if p95 <= +5% and error-rate delta <0.3%, ramp to 10% in 30m. If either fails, rollback to previous artifact (ab11ef22).
chris: :thumbsup: agree with thresholds. Also recommend enabling KV-warm for canary.
ryan: Oncall (ryan) here — I'll watch the canary and call rollback if slope >0.5%/5m. Also can we restrict initial canary to customers with no SSO?
maya: yes, deploybot set `--segmentation non-sso` in canary. deploybot please include fallback routing to ab11ef22 if health-check fails.
deploybot: deploybot: ack. Updated command: `deploy start --artifact ab12cd34 --canary 1 --region us-west1 --segmentation non-sso --fallback ab11ef22 --kv-warm`
sandeep: QA update: re-run perf with longer seq (4k tokens) — p95 holds at +3.2% now after cache warm. Error spikes were linked to one flaky worker (OOM). Patch in CI; not in this RC. Looks safe.
eva: Telemetry realtime: after KV-warm applied, error-rate regression eliminated in staging. Canary should be fine. I'll post a brief after 15m.
maya: ok plan: start canary at 03:15 PT, monitor for 30m. If green => ramp to 10% at 03:45, then 50% at 04:15 if still green, then full at 04:45. If any gate trips, ops roll back to ab11ef22. @ryan you'll be primary sheriff.
sheriff: got it, I'll be available. Confirm release notes are updated with known OOM caveat and rollback instructions.
maya: release notes: `RC-47: latency optimizations, kv-cache improvements; known issue: marginal OOMs on low-memory worker (ticket #INF-789). Rollback steps included.` Link: https://confluence/redwood/rc-47-notes
chris: Approved from infra: GPU pool pinned, autoscaler locked for promo window.
ryan: Watching the canary; will call out within 10m of detection.
maya: final signoff: maya: ✅, chris: ✅, sandeep: ✅, eva: ✅, ryan: ✅. Proceeding with canary.
deploybot: deploybot: starting canary now (artifact ab12cd34 -> us-west1, 1%). Live logs: https://deploy/redwood/logs/ab12cd34
eva: 15m update: canary metrics stable, p95 +2.1%, error-rate +0.05%. No user-impact signals. :tada:
maya: ramp to 10% at 03:45 PT. deploybot?
deploybot: deploybot: ramping to 10% in us-west1. `deploy ramp --artifact ab12cd34 --region us-west1 --to 10`
sandeep: QA smoke on 10% looks clean. Deploybot, please schedule global 50% at 04:15 PT but only if metrics remain green.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled ramp to 50% at 04:15 PT with automatic hold if any health-monitor trips.
ryan: All good on my side. No anomalous logs. Leaving notes in incident channel.
maya: Noted. Keeping pin until 05:00 PT as buffer. Thanks team.
